review.editorial: Separate full Chinese review checked voice, causal geography, bodily movement and passage of time. Refined a descriptive detail, reread fixed source, then reviewed complete English before finalization.
review.continuity_or_facts: Compared prior ending/checkpoint and established physical limits. Tracked supply custody, consequences, chronology and limited knowledge; reader transition from prior chapter correct. Private records prepared from actual prose.
review.english_alignment: Reviewed all 75 English units and 763 chunks for naturalness, fidelity and distinct spans. Exact source, boundaries and deterministic output validate without warnings. Contextual pronunciation/slice checks pass. Saved sentence and Listen source units inspected without speech.
